items.title: [负面] Since recent D-tide change the balance went somewh...
items.summary:
Since recent D-tide change the balance went somewhere else... When the Devs introdused AA(+12), they promised that content will never require +12 characters(lie). And now they are trying to merge JP server with Global. But they promised before that they will never do this(another lie).
People are complaining that the “poison” and “counter” comps don't work at all anymore. At the same time, the dev is spinning tales that those poison/counter comps are fine(even though, in reality, no one has ever seen any proof of this).

As it stands now, I wouldn't recommend the game to anyone. The developers are liars, and they're trying to pull off the same tactics as Mihoyo. The problem is, they've forgotten that they're nowhere near as good as Mihoyo...
